conventions.normal: DX for every ambientCG surface (Ryan ruling 1, 2026-08-02, reversing an earlier GL assertion). Consumed directly — no green-channel flip anywhere. The GL maps also ship, role 'normal-gl', UNUSED.
conventions.surface_tile_m: tiling period in metres. SURFACES ONLY; ABSENT (not null) on meshes.
conventions.mesh_extent_m: world-space bounding-box WIDTH in metres, i.e. the larger horizontal extent, not height. MESHES ONLY; ABSENT (not null) on surfaces.
conventions.size_source: vendor = published by the asset site. assumed = a starting value for tuning, NOT a measurement. measured = read from the file by this pipeline. A consumer that would behave differently for an assumed value must branch on this field.
